decision.title: Phase gates closed by agent review

body.p: . The project owner chose, when asked, that work proceeds through the phases until XQuery 4.0 and XSLT 4.0 work, with each gate closed by a separate review agent instead of a human. The review agent checks the work against docs/C_GUIDELINES.md and the gate criteria; its findings are fixed before the next phase starts. Gate boxes ticked this way are marked "(agent review)" so a later human review can find them. The substrate freeze at the Phase 1 gate still applies: later substrate changes need a record here.
